# Nanjing Kairong Machinery Tech. Co., Ltd.

> Leading manufacturer of twin screw extruders and plastic processing machinery for polymer, recycling, and specialty applications.

Nanjing Kairong Machinery specializes in designing and manufacturing advanced extrusion equipment for diverse industries including plastics, pet food, hot melt adhesives, and bioplastics. Based in Nanjing, Jiangsu, the company serves global markets through Made-in-China as a trusted supplier of industrial polymer processing machinery.

## Key Topics

- Twin Screw Extruder
- Plastic Machinery
- Underwater Pelletizer
- Polymer Processing
- Plastic Recycling
- Masterbatch Extruder
- PET/ABS/TPU Processing
- Hot Melt Adhesive Extruder

- Plastic Granulator
